description: This PHP source file defines an event subscriber class 'AdministratorAccessSubscriber' within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class subscribes to kernel controller events and modifies user admin access rights based on the controller being invoked, integrating with Symfony framework components.

classes.name: AdministratorAccessSubscriber
classes.description: Event subscriber that listens to Symfony Kernel controller events to control administrator access rights based on the controller being invoked.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber is registered for, specifically the kernel controller event with a high priority.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles controller events, disables admin access if the controller is an instance of AbstractVueController, unless it is AdminPrivilegeController.
